title: TrustFix: Price updates, service isolation, booking form options, and WhatsApp button wiring

requirements.summary: Reduce all painting package prices by exactly ₹1 in the services data file
acceptanceCriteria: Every painting package price shown in the UI is exactly ₹1 lower than before.
No painting card layout, color, or image is changed.
No other service prices are affected.

file_operations.description: In the services array, locate all painting service entries and reduce each price field by exactly ₹1. For example: ₹18/sqft → ₹17/sqft, ₹19 → ₹18, ₹17 → ₹16, ₹13 → ₹12, ₹9 → ₹8, ₹5 → ₹4. Update only the numeric price values in the painting service objects; do not modify any other properties, structure, or service entries.

requirements.summary: Update cleaning service prices and display flow labels for Villa/Commercial/Carpet services
acceptanceCriteria: Bathroom shows ₹449, Sofa shows ₹699, Mattress shows ₹799, Kitchen shows ₹1499.
Home cleaning cards show all six BHK/occupancy tiers with the correct prices.
Villa, Commercial, and Carpet cards display 'Free Inspection → Quote → Service' instead of a numeric price.
No other cleaning card visuals are changed.

file_operations.description: In the services array, locate all cleaning service entries and update prices to: Bathroom – ₹449, Sofa – ₹699, Mattress – ₹799, Kitchen – ₹1499. For home cleaning subcategories, set: 1BHK Vacant – ₹2499, 1BHK Occupied – ₹3499, 2BHK Vacant – ₹3999, 2BHK Occupied – ₹4999, 3BHK Vacant – ₹5999, 3BHK Occupied – ₹6999. For Villa, Commercial, and Carpet cleaning entries, add a field or flag indicating these should display a flow label instead of a numeric price.

Update the price display logic to check if the service entry has a flow label flag. If present, render the text 'Free Inspection → Quote → Service' instead of the numeric price badge. Otherwise, display the numeric price as before. Do not change the card layout, colors, or other visual elements.

requirements.summary: Isolate service detail pages so only the selected service's subcategories are displayed
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking/navigating to Pest Control shows only pest control subcategory cards.
Clicking/navigating to Cleaning shows only cleaning subcategory cards.
Clicking/navigating to Painting shows only painting subcategory cards.
No cards from other service categories appear on any of these pages.

file_operations.description: Review the current rendering logic that displays service subcategories. Ensure that when a user navigates to Pest Control, Cleaning, or Painting, only that specific service's subcategory cards are rendered. Remove any code that conditionally displays cards from other service categories on the same view. Verify that the filtering or conditional rendering logic strictly isolates each service's detail page to show only its own subcategories.

requirements.summary: Add a conditional 'Property Type' select field to the booking form for Pest Control, Cleaning, and Painting services
acceptanceCriteria: When Pest Control, Cleaning, or Painting is selected as the service type, a Property Type field appears with the six options.
The Property Type field is hidden for other service types.
The selected property type is included in the booking submission payload.

file_operations.description: Add a new 'Property Type' select field to the booking form. This field should display with options: 1BHK, 2BHK, 3BHK, Square Feet, Villa, Commercial. Show this field only when the selected service type is Pest Control, Cleaning, or Painting. Hide the field for all other service types. Update the form submission logic to include the selected property type in the booking payload sent to the backend. Map the selected option to the corresponding PropertyType enum value from the backend interface (oneBhk, twoBhk, threeBhk, squareFeet, villa, commercial).
